newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - California Micro raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - California Micro raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Bros analyst Erika Klauer said in a research note she raised her recommendation on California Micro Devices Corp to strong buy from hold.

-- Klauer cited reduced manufacturing costs, products that are made more efficiently and with fewer components, an expected increase in 1998 order levels, and the recent settlement of a class action lawsuit involving the company, which should save the company $1 million per year in expenses.
-- Fiscal 1997 earnings estimate is unchanged at $0.08 per share, and the 1998 estimate has been raised $0.05, to $0.45 a share.
-- A preliminary fiscal 1999 estimate of $1.00 per share has been set, and the 12-month share price target is $12.
-- Shares were up 1-3/16 to 8-1/8 in midday Nasdaq trade.
